0022600185.text: The Kings host the Los Angeles Lakers in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 1-6 and 5th in the Pacific, 4 games back, while the Lakers come in at 5-2 and 1st in the Pacific. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost 1-3 to the Lakers in 2025-26, including a 128-104 loss in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026.
